description: Linear Fresnel collector with two-axis IAM (longitudinal + transversal), end-loss, and physics-based receiver heat loss (convection + radiation). Cavity receiver geometry.

unit.name: Linear Fresnel collector representative (Häberle 2002 Solarmundo-type)
unit.source: Zhu et al. (2014) Solar Energy 103; Häberle et al. (2002) Eurosun; Forristall (2003) NREL TP-550-34169

total_mirror_width.note: Total width of all parallel mirror rows

h_conv.note: Cavity convective heat transfer coefficient (lower than exposed PT receiver due to cavity)

focal_length.note: Height of absorber above mirror rows

rho_mirror.note: Mirror reflectance (flat glass mirrors, slightly lower than parabolic)

intercept_factor.note: Fraction of reflected DNI reaching absorber

iam_coefficients.source: Häberle et al. (2002); Zhu et al. (2014)

b_T.note: Transversal IAM polynomial: IAM_T = 1 - b_T * theta_T^2
